title: superloop Board heartbeat
description: One file per loop at $SUPERLOOP_RUN_DIR/agents/<agent_id>.json, replaced atomically by sl-emit. A point-in-time snapshot; tasks[] is a full board snapshot, never a delta.

branch.description: advisory only; multiple loops may share it; never a mutex

worktree.description: worktree root (== repo_path unless a linked worktree)

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC Z; loop registration time, immutable

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC Z; bumped on every emit; the PRIMARY liveness clock

pid.description: advisory only; readers use updated_at age as the primary liveness signal (Claude Code tool calls have no stable per-agent pid)

tasks.description: full unit-board snapshot each emit; small list, re-serialized so the reader stays stateless

status.description: Jira columns; ledger queue status maps here (open->backlog, awaiting-approval|unverified->review)
